scenario_decoding.claim: The trailing '60' is the Syndra module's Splinters of Wrath option set to 60; 'custom_order' is the non-default cast order this champion's custom slot map produces.
why: data/champion-audit/batch-6.json (Syndra): 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage (12%+2%/100 AP), P 120-splinter +15% AP buff'. 60 is one of the kit's exact documented thresholds (40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120), not an arbitrary number.

data/champion-audit/batch-6.json (Syndra): module_slots.modeled = [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R], 'modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)' -> Syndra's slot list is itself custom (5 castable slots, not the usual 4).

data/worklists/f2-task.md: 'src/calculator/damage.py computes a rotation from a DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (fixed Q,W,E,R)' with 'a documented fallback (default Q,W,E,R order) for champions with no combo signal'. The OLD leaf value E is exactly index 2 of that naive default Q,W,E,R -- i.e. the old snapshot is the fallback order, with Syndra's custom Q2 slot absent.
data/champion-audit/batch-p1-3.json shows cast_order is a real per-scenario input ('cast_order R,Q,W,E' for Vladimir), confirming a '*_custom_order_*' scenario exercises a non-default order.
scenario_decoding.caveat: The scenario definition itself lives in scripts/ (golden_snapshot.py), which this runbook forbids reading. The decoding above is reconstructed from cached data only.

step_1_second_dark_sphere_charge_is_live.source_quote: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.Q[0].effects[1].description: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.'
step_1_second_dark_sphere_charge_is_live.corroboration: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.Q[0].rechargeRate = [7,7,7,7,7] (Q is a charge/ammo ability, not a plain cooldown); data/wiki-atoms/stack-transform-summon-resource.json lists "Syndra's Dark Sphere" under 'stocked ability casts' ammo; data/worklists/e3-stacks.json repeats the 40-splinter charge hint.
step_1_second_dark_sphere_charge_is_live.arithmetic: 60 >= 40 -> charge cap = 2 -> two Dark Sphere casts are available back-to-back at fight start. The timeline therefore holds TWO Q-family casts (Q and the synthetic Q2 slot) before the next ability, occupying indices 0 and 1.

step_2_Q_must_precede_W_and_E_apply_befo.source_quote_W: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.W[0].effects[0].description: 'Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster within 500 units from the target location...'
step_2_Q_must_precede_W_and_E_apply_befo.source_quote_E: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.E[0].effects[1].description: 'Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units... Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds...'
step_2_Q_must_precede_W_and_E_apply_befo.design_rule_quote: data/worklists/f2-task.md: 'setup/consume relationships (e.g. Cassiopeia Q poisons BEFORE E spam...)' and 'the fight should cast the OPTIMAL rotation (apply-before-consume...)'
step_2_Q_must_precede_W_and_E_apply_befo.conclusion: Both W and E consume Dark Spheres that Q creates, so both stocked Q charges lead. Resulting head of the rotation: index0 = Q, index1 = Q (2nd charge / Q2 slot), index2 = the first non-Q ability.

step_3_which_non_Q_ability_is_third_W_or.source_quote_W_bonus: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.W[0].effects[3].description: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.' Leveling rows: Magic Damage [70,100,130,160,190] (+65% AP); Total Mixed Damage [78.4,112,145.6,179.2,212.8] (+74.2/74.8/75.4/76/76.6% AP) (+1.14% AP quadratic term).
step_3_which_non_Q_ability_is_third_W_or.source_quote_E_threshold: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.E[0].effects[2].description: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath enhances Scatter the Weak...' -> at 60 splinters E receives NO bonus (60 < 80), and its 80-splinter bonus is scatter-angle + slow, i.e. utility, not damage.

rank5_comparison_at_60_splinters.all_ranks_check: rank1 W-E = +18.4 + 0.142*AP; rank3 = +15.6 + 0.154*AP; rank5 = +12.8 + 0.166*AP -- W strictly outdamages E at every rank once the 60-splinter true damage is live.
rank5_comparison_at_60_splinters.contrast_without_the_60_bonus: W would price 190 + 0.65*AP vs E 200 + 0.60*AP at rank 5, i.e. W - E = -10 + 0.05*AP, so E outdamages W for all AP < 200. The 60-splinter threshold is exactly what makes W-before-E unconditional.

step_4_feasibility_checks.mana: Syndra mana at level 18 = 480 + 40*17*(0.7025 + 0.0175*17) = 480 + 680 = 1160 (data/champions.json stats.mana, growth formula per CLAUDE.md). Q+Q+W+E+R at max rank = 60+60+100+50+100 = 370 mana. No mana gating can drop a cast from the head of the rotation.
step_4_feasibility_checks.shared_timeline: docs/math-foundations.md section 1.1: 'Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.' Q castTime 'none', W castTime 'none', E/R castTime 0.25 -- no cast-time collision reorders the first three entries; the head of the timeline is the cast order itself.

why_the_old_value_is_wrong: E at index 2 is precisely index 2 of the naive DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER Q,W,E,R quoted in data/worklists/f2-task.md -- a timeline in which Syndra's 40-splinter second Dark Sphere charge never appears and her 60-splinter W true-damage rider never influences priority. Both of those are live at splinters = 60 per the cached wiki text. Under either mechanism independently (the extra Q charge shifting everything one slot right, or W outdamaging E once the 60-splinter true damage applies), E cannot be the third cast.
confidence: high on the domain math (two independent cached-wiki mechanisms agree on W); medium on the scenario decoding, since the scenario's literal inputs live in scripts/ which this runbook forbids reading.
